The parent in question has a routine of giving this toy each year, but this time they stopped because the child doesn't play with them as much as they used to.

Now, I need to evaluate if not buying the Beanie Baby this year is morally acceptable. Morally acceptable actions are those that don't harm others, respect their well-being, and are in line with societal norms.

Alternatively, the parent might be trying to save money or find a better gift that the child would appreciate more.
